scope: Expose the existing Schedule item-count bounds as a native accessible numeric Inspector control.

verified_gap.issue: The Schedule item-count control used a text input even though the existing schedule schema and command constrain the value to integer 1 through 50.
verified_gap.impact: Keyboard, touch and assistive-technology users received no native numeric input affordance or min/max/step semantics; invalid boundary values were silently clamped without the UI declaring that range.

implementation.change: The existing Schedule count field now uses native input[type=number], numeric input mode, min=1, max=SCHEDULE_LIMIT_MAX, step=1 and required semantics. It retains the existing command, clamp behavior, Undo history and Save/Publish boundaries.
implementation.reuse_review: Reuses the project's existing native numeric-control pattern in the shared Inspector renderer; no third-party code or dependency added.

acceptance.result: PASS 2/2 real Chromium scenarios at 390px and 1366px
checks: type, min, max, step and required semantics match the schedule schema
values below and above the range clamp to 1 and 50
the valid count persists with other Schedule settings to draft Save and explicit Publish
Save leaves the published snapshot unchanged and Publish updates it
